meta.question: Implement proton track structure (Geant4-DNA option2: Rudd ionisation + Miller-Green excitation + Born), ejecting electrons into the existing cascade, and validate the proton CSDA range.
meta.method: New proton.wgsl primary shader (one thread per proton, straight-line heavy particle). Rudd ionisation total (tabulated) + analytical Rudd secondary-electron differential (1/(1+w)^2 importance sampling); Miller-Green excitation (analytical); Born ion/exc >500 keV. Ejected electrons -> sec_buf -> existing electron cascade. CSDA measured natively over 30 keV - 5 MeV.

validation.bethe_cross_check_1MeV: Bethe stopping at 1 MeV = 266 MeV cm^2/g = 26.6 eV/nm -> range ~24-26 um; ours 26.3 um (1.07x). INDEPENDENTLY VALIDATED.
validation.bragg_peak: Rudd ionisation peaks at 0.045 nm^2 @ 57 keV (known Geant4-DNA proton ion peak)
validation.W_trend: W rises 28->58 eV with energy (correct: harder delta-rays at high velocity)

bugs_fixed: Cross-section grid misalignment: PRI/PBI/PBX must share ONE energy grid for the single log-index lookup (Born was reading the 10 MeV value at 1 MeV -> 12x over-range)

Rudd secondary sampler: uniform-w rejection fails ~99% at high E (wmax huge); switched to 1/(1+w)^2 importance sampling (the mean energy loss falls only as ~1/(1+w), dominated by hard collisions) -> high-E ranges 2-3x -> 1.1x
result.caveat: PSTAR reference values used during development were unverified and internally inconsistent; the Bethe cross-check (1 MeV, 1.07x) is the reliable validation. Full Geant4-DNA proton-CSDA oracle run is the next validation step. Low-E (<70 keV) and charge-exchange (Dingfelder, deferred) + ion-elastic are not yet added.

status: pass — proton track structure implemented + Bethe-validated at 1 MeV (1.07x); first protons in the engine
